_note: Maintainer-curated catalog. 'id' is a Chrome Web Store extension ID (all checked against the live store on 2026-11-17); the Add button fetches that package through /v1/api/crx/:id. Name, icon and description are refreshed from the store at runtime (/v1/api/ext-meta/:id); the values here are what shows first. For a self-hosted package instead, drop the file in public/store/packages/ and use { "name": "...", "path": "/store/packages/file.zip", ... }.
